summary.task: Extract professional summary details from the provided resume text.
instructions: Extract years_of_experience ONLY if explicitly mentioned in the text. Do NOT estimate or calculate from dates.
core_expertise must contain only 3-5 items explicitly mentioned. Do NOT add assumed or common domains.

schema.professional_title: The most recent or target job title.
schema.years_of_experience: Total number of years mentioned as an integer.
schema.core_expertise: A list of the top 3-5 high-level domains or industries.

example.input: Seasoned Java Developer with 8 years in Fintech building high-frequency trading apps.

output.short_bio: 8 years of experience as a Java Developer specializing in Fintech and trading applications.

education.task: Identify the highest degree and list others from the resume text.
instructions: Set graduation_year to null if NOT explicitly mentioned in the text. Do NOT invent or estimate years.
Highest degree is the most recent graduation date, not the most prestigious institution.

example.input: BS in Physics from University of XYZ 2018. MS in Computer Science from Stanford University 2020.

experience.task: Extract the most recent job in detail and list previous roles.
instructions: technologies_used must ONLY include tools/languages explicitly stated in the text. Do NOT assume or add common technologies like React, Docker if not mentioned.
Do NOT infer or hallucinate technologies. If no technologies are mentioned, return an empty list.

current_role.title: Most recent job title.
key_achievements: List of 3 primary responsibilities or wins.

example.input: Senior Dev at TechCorp (2021-Present) using React. Led team of 5. Previously, Junior Dev at SoftInc for 2 years.

skills.task: Identify and categorize technical skills from the resume text.
instructions: Each skill must appear in EXACTLY ONE category. Do NOT repeat the same skill across multiple categories.
Verify categorization matches the example: e.g., 'REST' and 'GraphQL' go in 'other_skills', not in 'frameworks'.

other_skills: Any additional relevant skills not covered above.

example.input: Proficient in Python, Java, and JavaScript. Experienced with Django, React, and Vue.js. Familiar with AWS, Docker, and Git. Also skilled in Agile methodologies, team leadership, and API design. Knowledge of REST and GraphQL.

projects.task: Extract key projects from the resume text.
instructions: technologies array must contain ONLY technologies explicitly mentioned in the input. Do NOT add inferred libraries like 'Scikit-learn' unless mentioned.
outcome must reference metrics or impact explicitly stated in the text. Do NOT invent or assume quantifiable results.

projects.name: Project name.
projects.outcome: Key result or impact (quantifiable if possible).

example.input: Built a real-time chat application using Node.js and MongoDB. Reduced latency by 40%. Also developed an ML recommendation engine with Python and TensorFlow, increasing user engagement by 25%.

projects.name: ML Recommendation Engine
projects.description: Machine learning system for personalized product recommendations.

projects.name: Real-time Chat Application
projects.description: Messaging platform with real-time synchronization capabilities.

certifications.task: Extract professional certifications and credentials from the resume text.
instructions: Set credential_id to null if NOT explicitly mentioned. Do NOT hallucinate or invent credential numbers.
Dates must be in YYYY-MM or YYYY format only. If date format cannot be determined, use null.

certifications.name: Certification name.
certifications.issue_date: Date obtained (YYYY-MM or YYYY format, or null).
certifications.expiry_date: Expiration date if applicable (YYYY-MM or YYYY format, or null).

example.input: AWS Certified Solutions Architect (December 2022). Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer (November 2021, valid until November 2024). Certified Kubernetes Administrator (Credential ID: CKA-12345, issued March 2023).

education_certifications.task: Extract education and certifications details from the resume text.
instructions: Do NOT duplicate any certification between the education.other_degrees and certifications sections.
graduation_year and issue_date must use only YYYY or YYYY-MM format. Do NOT estimate or invent dates not in text.

certifications.name: Certification name.
certifications.issue_date: Date obtained (YYYY-MM or YYYY format, or null).
certifications.expiry_date: Expiration date if applicable (YYYY-MM or YYYY format, or null).

example.input: MS in Computer Science from MIT (2020, GPA: 3.9), B.S. in Physics from University of XYZ (2018). AWS Certified Solutions Architect (December 2022). Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer (November 2021, valid until November 2024).

skills_technologies.task: Extract and categorize skills and technologies from the resume text.
instructions: Each skill must appear in EXACTLY ONE category. No skill should be repeated across multiple categories.
Verify no duplicates between categories (e.g., if 'REST' is in other_skills, do NOT also add to frameworks or tools).

other_skills: Any additional relevant skills not covered above.

example.input: Proficient in Python, Java, and JavaScript. Experienced with Django, React, and Vue.js. Familiar with AWS, Docker, and Git. Also skilled in Agile methodologies, team leadership, and API design. Knowledge of REST and GraphQL.

experience_projects.task: Extract the most recent job experience and key projects from the resume text.
instructions: Technologies in both current_role and projects must be explicitly mentioned in the input text. Do NOT add inferred or assumed technologies.
Project outcomes must reference only quantifiable metrics that are actually stated in the text. Do NOT estimate or invent impact numbers.

current_role.title: Most recent job title.
key_achievements: List of 3 primary responsibilities or wins.

projects.name: Project name.
projects.outcome: Key result or impact (quantifiable if possible).
